studio.faq_titulo: What you need to know before you start
studio.faq_1_q: How does a book shoot work at House Mazzutti Studio?
studio.faq_1_a: The process starts with a briefing call to understand your goal — model, entrepreneur, influencer or executive. From there, we develop the visual concept, select locations and conduct the session with editorial image direction. The images go through professional editing and finishing before delivery.
studio.faq_2_q: What is included in a personal shoot?
studio.faq_2_a: The personal shoot includes concept briefing, image direction, planned location, photo and/or video session, editing and delivery of the selected images in high resolution. The number of images and session length vary by the chosen package.
studio.faq_3_q: Do you do event coverage in São Paulo?
studio.faq_3_a: Yes. House Mazzutti does on-location coverage of events, brand activations, openings and launches. We work with real-time photo and video, with image direction and curation at the event itself.
studio.faq_4_q: How much does a professional book cost?
studio.faq_4_a: The investment varies with the scope — model, entrepreneur or executive; half session or full session; photo or photo + video. Get in touch to receive the package list and a personalized quote.

produtora_page.cta_titulo: It's not about showing up more. It's about showing up better.
produtora_page.concepts_text: Before producing, we structure. At HMZT Production, we manage complete audiovisual production, advertising campaigns, strategic content and creative direction for brands and marketing teams that challenge the conventional.
produtora_page.servicos_titulo: Executive production and artistic casting for advertising and content marketing.

produtora_page.servico_3_subtitle: Where the company gains presence and clarity.
produtora_page.testimonial_1_text: Film with international standards, led by the same direction that signed the concept. The briefing became editorial material without noise.
produtora_page.testimonial_2_text: Lookbook, film and content were born from the same mind. A coherent narrative — not three disconnected deliveries.
produtora_page.testimonial_3_text: The director was on set for every decision. We came out with a film that sustains an entire season.
produtora_page.faq_titulo: What you need to know before starting
produtora_page.faq_1_q: What does an executive production company do in a campaign?
produtora_page.faq_1_a: The executive producer is responsible for everything that happens before, during and after the set: budget, schedule, hiring of technical crew, casting, locations, set design, art direction and final delivery. At House Mazzutti, this process is integrated with creative direction from the concept.
produtora_page.faq_2_q: Do you handle casting and set design?
produtora_page.faq_2_a: Yes. HMZT Production covers casting (model and talent selection), set design (creation and execution of the set environment) and all production coordination. All under a single creative direction.
produtora_page.faq_3_q: Does the Production company serve fashion and beauty brands?
produtora_page.faq_3_a: Yes — fashion and beauty are the main segments of HMZT Production. We have experience in campaigns for cosmetics brands, women's fashion, jewelry and accessories, as well as institutional campaigns.
produtora_page.faq_4_q: How to start a campaign with House Mazzutti?
produtora_page.faq_4_a: The first step is a briefing conversation — campaign objective, product, audience and references. From there, we develop the creative concept and present the production proposal. Use the contact form or WhatsApp to get started.

agencia.faq_titulo: What you need to know before starting

faq.q: How long does a branding project at House Mazzutti take?
faq.a: A complete branding project takes between 6 and 12 weeks, depending on the complexity of the brand. The process goes through Immersion, Market Reading, Concept, Execution and Fine Art before final delivery.

faq.q: What is the difference between branding and visual identity?
faq.a: Visual identity is the graphic system (logo, colours, typography). Branding is the brand's value architecture — positioning, voice, strategy and how all of this translates visually. At House Mazzutti, we do complete branding, from strategy to execution.

faq.q: Does House Mazzutti serve brands outside São Paulo?
faq.a: Yes. We serve brands from all over Brazil remotely. For projects that require on-set presence, we primarily operate in São Paulo, but we carry out productions in other cities by appointment.

faq.q: How does the investment in a branding project work?
faq.a: Each project is budgeted individually after a briefing conversation. The investment varies according to the scope — new brand, repositioning or complete system. Contact us via the form to receive a proposal.

academy_page.seo_desc: Practical training for photographers, videomakers, models, directors, and creative industry professionals. The method of those still on set. House Mazzutti — São Paulo.

academy_page.hero_subtitulo: Workshops and materials for creative professionals who want to grow in their craft with those who live it.
academy_page.manifesto_titulo: The method of those on set — for those who want to get there.
academy_page.manifesto_texto: The Academy is House Mazzutti's educational arm — not a detour from the work, but a natural extension of it. What goes into the course came from the set, from a real brief, from the project that worked. Those who teach are those who operate. And those who operate never lose touch with what the market demands today.

academy_page.produto_2_desc: Set knowledge condensed. Real decisions on briefing, direction and production — straight to the point.
academy_page.produto_3_desc: Notes and essays on branding, creative direction, and building value in the creative market.

academy_page.perfil_2: Models who want to understand the market before entering it.
academy_page.perfil_3: Creative directors and advertisers in search of a personal method.
academy_page.perfil_4: Beauty professionals who work with image and want to position themselves in the market.
academy_page.perfil_5: Producers and project managers in the creative market.

academy_page.diferencial_2_desc: Each course delivers decisions, not concepts. What to change tomorrow, how to apply it this week.
academy_page.diferencial_3_desc: The same aesthetic and strategic criteria that guides the Production, Agency and Studio — translated into training.
